target_audience: Enterprise Ireland Evaluators, B2B Fleet Managers
core_philosophy: Authoritative, data-dense, human-crafted precision. Strip out all AI gimmicks and replace them with high-fidelity, Bloomberg-esque tabular layouts and stark, trustworthy contrasts.

headings.rationale: Geometric, highly legible, modern but corporate-safe. Removes the 'generic template' feel of Inter.

body.rationale: The ultimate data-table font. Monospaced numerals built-in, highly legible at small sizes.

primary.rationale: Shifted from blue-600 to blue-700. A deeper, more authoritative 'Royal/Navy' blue that screams established enterprise, not startup.

header.rationale: Replaces the purple gradient. Deep slate provides a solid, command-center anchor at the top of the screen.

spacing_and_layout.dashboard_grid: Grid Layout Technical Rules (CRITICAL). Strict grid hierarchy. Mode B: High Density Grid. Gap: gap-4 or gap-6.
spacing_and_layout.cards: p-5 or p-6. Flat solid background. 1px subtle border (border-slate-200), NO shadow or very soft shadow-sm. Radii: rounded-lg or rounded-md (max 8px).
spacing_and_layout.tables: Tight spacing. py-2.5 px-4 for table cells. text-sm for all rows. text-xs font-semibold tracking-wider uppercase text-slate-500 for headers. border-b border-slate-200.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: All financial/mileage metrics right-aligned. Dates/Status center-aligned. Names/IDs left-aligned.

component_polish.kpi_stat_cards: Remove drop shadows. Use 1px border-slate-200. Value must be Manrope, text-3xl, font-semibold. Add a subtle Phosphor icon (Duotone) in top right in slate-400.
component_polish.status_pills: Use the semantic_status definitions. Must be rounded-full, px-2.5 py-0.5, text-xs font-medium. Never use pure bright colors as backgrounds; always tinted-50 background with tinted-700 text and an inset ring.
component_polish.fleet_board_timeline: Strict geometrical grid. Vertical day columns with border-r border-slate-100. Booking blocks should have sharp corners (rounded-sm) and solid backgrounds (e.g. bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 border-l-2 border-blue-600). Make it look like an engineering Gantt chart, not a calendar app.
component_polish.buttons: Primary: bg-blue-700 text-white rounded-md px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium hover:bg-blue-800 transition-colors. Secondary: bg-white text-slate-700 border border-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-50.
component_polish.empty_states: No illustrations. Use a single, large Phosphor icon (e.g., ClipboardText) in slate-300. Title in slate-900, description in slate-500. Center aligned. Clean and clinical.
component_polish.loading_skeletons: bg-slate-200 animate-pulse rounded-md. Do not use spinners for page loads, use skeleton blocks mimicking the tables and cards.

booking_intelligence.old_state: Dark neon/purple animated treatment with floating particles.
booking_intelligence.new_state: The 'Conflict Engine'. Stark white background. 1px border-slate-200. A simple green 'Active' pulse dot next to the header 'System Scanner'. Results shown in a dense, tabular format with IBM Plex Sans Mono. It should look like high-speed Bloomberg terminal output, proving it's running hard calculations, not making up a story.

anti_ai_slop_rules: No emojis anywhere (remove ✨, 🤖, 🚀). Use Phosphor icons instead.
No typewriter effect for intelligence outputs. Show data instantly in tables.
No gradient text or full-screen glowing gradients.
No blurry colored blobs in the background.
No center-everything disease. Left-align data for scannability.
No massive empty spaces. Utilize pixels efficiently for the fleet manager.

visual_enhancers.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react. Use 'Regular' weight for general UI, 'Duotone' for KPI cards.
visual_enhancers.micro_interactions: Hover states on table rows (bg-slate-50). Button active states scale down slightly (active:scale-[0.98]).

images.notes: Use these strictly for the public Landing Page. The dashboard should not contain decorative imagery.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Implement the font switch immediately: Import Manrope and IBM Plex Sans. Apply Manrope to all headers and IBM Plex Sans to body classes.
Remove the purple gradient from the header. Replace with bg-slate-900 border-b border-slate-800.
Scrub the entire 'Booking Intelligence' component. Strip all particles, framer-motion floaters, and purple themes. Rebuild it as a data-dense, stark white table component with monospace data points.
Convert all soft card shadows to border border-slate-200 shadow-sm.
Add data-testid attributes to all buttons, navigation links, and KPI cards.
instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT. The goal is an extreme pivot from 'startup AI toy' to 'established enterprise infrastructure'. Focus on density, tabular legibility, and high-contrast conservative coloring.
